usages.explain:
V-ません is the negative form of V-ます. In question sentences, we do not change the word order of the sentence but simply add the particle 「か」at the end of the sentence or replace the interrogative word in the position of the sentence element to be asked.
In responses, we repeat the verb from the question sentence and be careful not to use 「そうです」or「そうじゃありません」.

examples.transcription: わたしはさかなをたべません。

examples.content: 明日サントスさんは働きません。
examples.transcription: あしたさんとすさんははたらきません。
examples.mean: Mr. Santos won't be working tomorrow.

title: ません => be not doing something
